Solution: x is the son’s current age and y the mother’s. Both advance 8 years. System: y=3 × x; y+8=2 × (x+8). Isolate y: y=(3)x+(0). Substitute into the other equation: (-2)x+(1)[(3)x+(0)]=8. Combine: (1)x=8, so x=8. Then y=(3)(8)+(0)=24. Check both equations: -3(8)+1(24)=0; -2(8)+1(24)=8. Requested answer: 8.
